skills.name: smappy-live-fitting
skills.description: Fit single-molecule localization data (SMLM) with SMAPpy while it is acquired or after, with the reconstruction shown in SMAPpy's window.

psf.description: PSF model: gaussian for 2D (no calibration); spline for 3D with a bead calibration (then calibration is required). Ask the user; never guess.

channels.description: 1 for one channel; 2 for a split two-channel image (two colours or biplane). Ask the user; never guess.

calibration.description: Absolute path of the bead calibration (_3dcal.mat or .h5), usually saved beside the bead images; dual-colour mode for channels 2. Required for psf spline, not allowed otherwise.

transform.description: Absolute path of the channel transformation file (or a dual-colour bead calibration). Required for psf gaussian with channels 2, not allowed otherwise.

conversion_e_per_adu.description: Camera conversion, photoelectrons per count. Omit when SMAPpy's camera database or the dataset knows it; the worker refuses to start if nobody does.

offset_adu.description: Camera baseline in counts (the value of a pixel that saw no light). Omit when the database or the dataset knows it.

em_on.description: EMCCD only: whether EM gain was on. Omit for an sCMOS camera.

em_gain.description: EMCCD only: the EM gain the camera was set to. Required when EM gain was on and the dataset does not record it.

pixel_size_um.description: Pixel size in the sample, in micrometres. Omit when the dataset records it (Micro-Manager usually does).

camera.description: Name of an entry in SMAPpy's camera database, for a dataset whose camera cannot be identified from its metadata. Usually omitted.

roi_size_px.description: Side of the square fitted around each molecule, in camera pixels. Default 13; smaller is faster and suits dense data.

cutoff.description: Detection threshold: per frame, the median of the local maxima plus this many times their 20-80 % spread. Default 1.7; higher finds fewer, brighter molecules.

psf_sigma_px.description: Approximate PSF width in camera pixels, for detection (and the Gaussian fit's start). Default 1.2.
